verdict.rationale: vLLM's own documentation lists prefix caching as a core engine feature alongside continuous batching and chunked prefill (vllm-docs-3), so a power-user can use it for repeated-prompt workloads. A community comment notes that vLLM's KV caching mattered a lot in practice (vllm-comm-4), but it does not specifically confirm prefix-cache speedups. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on how to enable or configure prefix caching, measured speedup data for repeated-prompt workloads, and independent hands-on corroboration of prefix-cache gains.
